assertions.title: Fake auth auto-login (milestones 1-4)
assertions.reason: Opening the app root redirected directly to /dashboard with no login form shown.

steps.expected: Auto-authenticated user is taken directly to dashboard

steps.observed: Dashboard placeholder content rendered with nav links only; no login form
Browser captured GET /api/users/me; curl GET /api/users/me returned 200 with X-User-Id: 1

evidence.network: Browser: GET /api/users/me observed during load; curl GET http://localhost:8080/api/users/me -> 200

assertions.title: Create a category
assertions.reason: Creating a unique category succeeded and it remained visible after refresh.

steps.expected: Category is created and shown in list

assertions.title: Duplicate category name rejected
assertions.reason: Submitting an existing category name showed a clear duplicate error and did not create a second row.

steps.action: Open Create Category modal and submit existing name ut-ac-a-1774265
steps.observed: Error shown: Category with name 'ut-ac-a-1774265' already exists
Only one category entry with that name existed

assertions.title: Rename a category
assertions.reason: Renaming succeeded and the new name appeared in the transaction form category dropdown.

steps.expected: Updated name appears in categories list
Renamed category is present in category selector
steps.observed: Category option ut-ac-b-1774265 present in dropdown

assertions.title: Delete category with no transactions
assertions.reason: Deleting a category without linked transactions succeeded and removed it from the list.

assertions.title: Delete category blocked when transactions exist
assertions.reason: Deleting a category that had transactions returned a conflict and kept the category.

steps.action: Attempt to delete AuthTest E2E Food and confirm
steps.expected: Deletion is blocked with clear message
steps.observed: Modal displayed 'Cannot delete category with existing transactions' and category remained

assertions.title: Empty state when no categories
assertions.reason: After clearing transactions and categories for user 1, the categories page displayed a clear empty-state message.

steps.action: Remove remaining user transactions, then delete all categories

steps.observed: Page showed 'No categories yet' and 'Create one to get started.'

evidence.network: Final cleanup request: DELETE /api/categories/942 -> 204; follow-up GET /api/categories -> 200

assertions.title: Category name validation - empty rejected
assertions.reason: Whitespace-only category name was blocked client-side with a validation error and no API call.

steps.action: Open Create Category modal and submit whitespace name
steps.expected: Client-side validation error and no network request
steps.observed: Error 'Name is required' shown; request log had no POST /api/categories

evidence.network: No category API request sent (POST /api/categories absent)

assertions.title: Rename category to duplicate name rejected
assertions.reason: Renaming a category to another existing name returned a duplicate conflict and displayed a clear error message.

steps.action: Create ut-ac-c-1774265, then edit ut-ac-b-1774265 to ut-ac-c-1774265
steps.observed: Edit modal showed duplicate-name error and rename was not applied

frictions.description: The agent-browser `network requests` output did not include HTTP status codes by default.
frictions.resolution: Captured statuses via temporary in-page fetch logging and used curl for /api/users/me status confirmation.

frictions.description: Assigned user data was pre-populated with categories and transactions, so CAT-006 required cleanup before empty-state could be observed.
frictions.resolution: Deleted existing transactions and categories within X-User-Id: 1 scope, then verified empty-state UI.

summary: Tested 9 assertions: 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked. Auth auto-login and all assigned categories UI behaviors matched expectations for the fake-auth default user context.
